This PKGBUILD file appears to be a placeholder or initialization package rather than a properly built package. While there are several hygiene concerns (pkgver=0.0.0, dummy checksum 'DUMMY-FOR-INITIALIZATION' instead of SKIP or a real hash, and a package() function that only echoes "Placeholder"), these do not constitute genuine malicious behavior. The source URL still points to the expected GitHub repository (github.com/nabbisen/omriss), there's no obfuscated code, no exfiltration, and no execution of downloaded code. The package would fail to build properly due to the placeholder implementation, but it poses no immediate security threat as it doesn't download from unexpected hosts or execute malicious commands.
